provenance: Mutations of the six modules under `sources/`, proposed by gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 and hand-labelled one at a time. `equivalent` was decided by running the two versions over the inputs the surrounding program can reach, never by reading what the model said about its own proposal; `label` and `why` are the reader's account of that decision. The sources are frozen bytes: every span here is an offset into them, so editing one invalidates the file.
criterion: equivalent = no input the program can reach makes the two versions do different things. developer-likely = not equivalent, and a mistake that could really land. contrived = not equivalent, and a mistake nobody would make.
separable_at_function_level: Two of the equivalent mutations are separable when the function is called on its own: an earlier guard in the program makes the difference unreachable, and calling the function directly walks past that guard. They are named here so that a measurement of how often a judge is wrong is not also a measurement of a limit already known.
